title: Pip Can't Wait for the Moon!
moral: Good things are worth waiting for, and waiting is easier when we help each other.
description: Tonight is the Moon Party on Clover Hill, but it's only morning, and Pip the little fox can't wait! Can Pip, Tumble and Hazel make it night with scarves, floppy ears and a picnic blanket? Learn about day and night, the sun, the moon and the stars in this funny animated story about patience, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Tonight is the Moon Party on Clover Hill! Nana Hoot will show everyone the moon and the twinkly stars!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! I can't wait! Is it night yet? Is it? Is it?
Hmm... look up at the sky. What is shining up there right now?
The sun! You got it! When the sun shines and the sky is blue, it's DAY time.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Good morning, Pip! Is it night yet?

narration.text: Pip had a super-duper idea. He would MAKE it night! He pulled his scarf over his eyes.
Pip took one step and... ka-BONK! Right into the big oak tree. Wibble-wobble!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: My turn! I'll flop my big ears over my eyes. Now it's night! Oopsie-trunk...
Slip... slide... WHUMP! Tumble sat down on the soft grass with a giant bump.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! Silly friends! You can't make night. The sun is still up in the sky!

narration.text: So the friends tiptoed to Nana Hoot's tree house. But Nana was fast asleep! Zzz... zzz...
Pip whispered, Nana? And Tumble's trunk went... HONK!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Hoo-hoo-HOO! Oh, my glasses slipped again.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Owls like me sleep in the day and wake up at night. So, when do owls wake up? In the day, or at night?
At night! Well done! Nana smiled. Waiting is easier when we keep busy and help!

narration.text: All afternoon, the friends got the party ready. Tumble hung lanterns with his long trunk.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I know where the sun goes at night! It goes to bed in a giant sun-bed under the hill!
Tee-hee! Good guess, Pip, but no! Our world is like a big ball, and it slowly turns around and around.
When our side of the world turns away from the sun, the sky gets dark. That's NIGHT!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: So the sun doesn't need pyjamas? HONK! How silly!

narration.text: Look! The sun is sinking low, and the sky is turning pink and orange. This is called SUNSET!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: It's nearly night! Come on, let's RUN to the top of the hill!
ZIP! Pip zoomed ahead... then he stopped. Little Hazel was puffing far behind.
So Pip waited. He walked slowly, step by step, right beside her. What a patient friend!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Thank you for waiting for me, Pip! Tee-hee!
And then... it was NIGHT! The sky was dark, dark blue.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! Now I'm REALLY awake! Look up, everyone. What can you see in the night sky?
The moon and the stars! Yes! You're so smart!
Let's count the biggest twinkly stars with Pip. One... two... three... four... five!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Five stars! Waiting was worth it! Super-duper-dooper!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ooh! The moon looks like a big, round cookie! Can I have a nibble? HONK!
Tee-hee! The moon is not a cookie, Tumble! It's a huge, rocky ball, far, far away in space.
Then a firefly tickled Tumble's trunk. Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO!
The giant sneeze sent Pip and Hazel rolling down the soft grass. Boing... boing... BOING!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Wheee! That was fun! Again, Tumble! Again!
Let's remember! When the sun shines and the sky is blue, is it day, or night?
DAY! Super!
And when the sky is dark and we see the moon and stars, is it day, or night?
NIGHT! Hooray, you remembered!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: And good things are worth waiting for, my dears. Hoo-hoo-HOO!

narration.text: Later, Tumble had a sleepover in Pip's cosy burrow. The moon peeked in the round window.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Good night, moon. Good night, stars. See you tomorrow night! Yaaawn...
And up in her tree house, Nana Hoot was wide awake. Night is when owls play!
Pip learned that waiting can be fun when you keep busy and help your friends.
